evals.prompt: log an issue: in the new UI week view, when I drag a to-do card from Tuesday to Thursday the card moves fine but the day totals above the columns don't update until I hard refresh. Saw it on Chrome yesterday and again today. Draft the issue and show me what you'd file — do NOT actually file it.
evals.expected_output: A draft GitHub issue targeting w3mg/resultmaps-web-ui-2 with a behavior-focused title, a Problem section in problem-space, Given/When/Then scenarios (totals update immediately after drag, no refresh), a Missing tests list with red-then-green instructions, a Done-when tied to the tests, and zero implementation prescriptions.
assertions: Issue body contains at least one Given/When/Then scenario
Issue body has a Missing tests section listing at least one named test
Missing tests section explicitly instructs: add the test, watch it fail, then make it pass (red before green)
Issue body contains no implementation prescriptions: no routes, components, files to change, code snippets, or solution sketches
A Done-when / definition of done ties completion to the listed tests passing
Targets the frontend repo (w3mg/resultmaps-web-ui-2) with a behavior-focused title (describes behavior, not a solution)
A scenario captures that day totals update immediately after the drag without a refresh
